name: Channel-space linear transforms
plain: Treats channels as a vector space and applies random but seeded rotations, reflections and shears across selected channels. Rotations and reflections preserve per-pixel energy, while shear does not. A statistics match step exists to restore channel stats. Experimental, mostly for controlled scrambles.
math:
orthogonal: Q from QR of a seeded Gaussian matrix, x′=Qx
reflect: v unit; x′=x−2v(vᵀx)
shear: u,v unit; x′=x+αu(vᵀx)
also signed permutation, gating, quantize, clip, dropout, packed-slot transforms

props.params: selected channels, seed, alpha, mix, mask
